login.invalid: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.
login.legal: By signing in you agree to our <terms>terms</terms> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
login.intro: Your orders, saved addresses, wishlist and downloads live here.
login.codeIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
login.codeSent: If {{email}} has an account here, we sent it a 6-digit code. It works for 10 minutes. Check your spam folder if it isn’t there.
login.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from the email
login.codeWrong: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check the newest email or send a new code.
login.resent: We sent a new code. Only the newest one works.
login.resendFailed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

signup.intro: Keep your orders, addresses and downloads in one place, and save pieces to your wishlist.
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists
signup.terms: I agree to the <terms>terms and conditions</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
signup.newsletter: Send me the studio note twice a month. No discount noise.
signup.acceptTerms: Accept the terms to create your account.
signup.checkInbox: Check your inbox: we sent a link to confirm your email address.
signup.nameTooLong: Keep your first and last name under 80 characters together
signup.closed: Sign-up is closed on this store.

strength.hint: At least ten characters. A short sentence works well.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.pasteLink: Paste the link from the email
reset.requestIntro: Give us the email on your account and we will send a link to set a new password. The link is good for 30 minutes.
reset.sentIntro: If {{email}} has an account, we sent it a reset link. If nothing arrives in a few minutes, look in spam or try again.
reset.newIntro: Choose something at least ten characters long.
reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used.
reset.doneIntro: Your new password is set. Sign in with it to continue.
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.
reset.invalidLink: That does not look like a reset link. Paste the whole link from the email.

invite.title: Join the team
invite.needsLink: This page needs the link from your invite email. Open the email and follow the link again.
invite.expired: This invite link has expired, was revoked or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
invite.introAdminBy: {{inviter}} invited you to the {{store}} admin as an admin, with access to {{access}}.
invite.introStaffBy: {{inviter}} invited you to the {{store}} admin as staff, with access to {{access}}.
invite.introAdmin: You are invited to the {{store}} admin as an admin, with access to {{access}}.
invite.introStaff: You are invited to the {{store}} admin as staff, with access to {{access}}.
invite.hasAccount: You already have an account with this email
invite.enterPassword: Enter the password for this account
invite.passwordHint: The password you already use to sign in
invite.forgot: Forgot it? <reset>Reset your password</reset> and open this link again.

twoFactor.title: Enter your code
twoFactor.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this site. Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
twoFactor.label: Code
twoFactor.required: Enter the 6-digit code from your app, or a recovery code

notice.ownerLink: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Open the portal again from the dashboard, or sign in below.
notice.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact the store.

checks.unmet: Your password does not meet every rule below yet
checks.common: That password is too common. Choose another.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.intro: One click and your account is ready.
verify.setPassword: Your email is confirmed. Check your inbox for a link to choose your password.
verify.resendIntro: Need a new link? Enter your email and we will send one.
verify.resent: If that email has an account waiting for confirmation, we sent a new link.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email
confirmEmail.intro: Your account will sign in with this address from now on. Every device is signed out once you confirm.
confirmEmail.incomplete: This link is not complete. Open it again from the email, or ask for a new one in your account.
confirmEmail.taken: That address belongs to another account now. Ask for a new link.

errors.network: The site did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
errors.rateLimited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
errors.badLink: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.csrf: This form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this store yet.
errors.emailNotReal: Use an email address you can get mail at. Throwaway addresses don’t work here.
errors.unverified: Confirm your email address first. We sent you a new link.
errors.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact the store.
errors.challengeExpired: This sign-in took too long. Sign in again.
